title: P1 Mastery Expansion: Complete 11-Skill Foundation Stage Pool
description: 110 themed Primary 1 exercises (10 per CCEA Foundation Stage skill) spanning Linguistic Phonics Stage 1, sight words, subitising, Ten-Frames 1–10, bonds to 5, 2D shapes, and UK coins 1p–5p.

exercises.subject: literacy

prompt.text: Tap the picture that starts with /s/!

hint.text: Say "star" slowly — listen for the very first pure sound /s/.

feedback.encourageText: Good try! Listen closely to the start of "star".

exercises.offlineParentTip: Play 'I Spy with my little ear' on the walk to school using pure letter sounds (say 'ssss' rather than 'ess'). Spot things starting with s, a, t, p, i, or n.

prompt.text: How many stars are on the Ten-Frame?

hint.text: A full top row is 5 — tap each counter to count carefully.

feedback.encourageText: Almost! Tap each star to count one by one.

exercises.offlineParentTip: Roll a standard dot dice together and call out the number as quickly as you can without pointing to count each dot.
